column3: The ESA provided in connection with the Westown Square Mortgaged Property (0.6%) indicated that a portion of the Mortgaged Property was previously used by an industrial facility associated with coal furnace manufacturing from at least 1932 to 1963, with some of the related operations including a machine shop, chemical storage areas, welding areas, painting, and railroad siding tracks.
